title: इनमको नाम लिएर आत्महत्या गरेका झापाली युवा मानसिक रोगी भएको प्रहरीको दाबी
content:
No ads found for this position विराटनगर । बिचौलिया इनम सापकोटासँग आफ्नो नाम जोडेर झापा कनकाई नगरपालिकाका यशु खतिवडाले आत्महत्या गरेका छन् । दुई दिनअघि आत्महत्या गर्नुअघि उनले सामाजिक सञ्जालमा स्टाटस लेखेका थिए । फोटोग्राफी र भिडियोग्राफी व्यवसाय गर्दै आएका खतिवडा घरमै मृत फेला परेका हुन् । उनी झापाको लक्ष्मीपुरमा फोटो स्टुडियो सञ्चालन गर्थे । जिल्ला प्रहरी कार्यालय झापाका अनुसार उनले कोठामा चुकुल लगाएर आत्महत्या गरेका थिए । आत्महत्या गर्नुअघि खतिवडाले लेखेको स्टाटसमा प्रहरी हिरासतमा रहेका इनम सापकोटालाई जोडिएको छ । उनले लेखेका छन्, ‘मेरो गल्तिको सजाय मेरो परिवारलाई नदिनु होला । म आफूले आफैँलाई सजाय दिने छु । मेरो यो आज भोगिरहेको जिन्दगी नै मेरो लागि सजाय हो । सबै धर्मको सम्मान र शान्तिको काममा गर्दछु । आफ्नै मनको कारण यो सबै हुनभयो ।’ खतिवडाले आफूबाट कमजोरी भएको भन्दै सबैसँग क्षमायाचना गरेका छन् । उनले लेखेको अर्को स्ट्याटसमा भने बिचौलिया इनमको नाम जोडिएको थियो । उनले इनमको ह्वाटस्अपबाट म्यासेज आएको र डिलिट भएको दाबी गरेका छन् । उनले लेखेका छन्, ‘जुन ईनमको मोबाइल ह्वाट्सअपबाट आएको भनिएको त्यो मेरो परिवार र निर्दोष बुबालाई फसाउन अरू कसैले रचिरहेका नाटक मात्र हो । अरू नै कसैले म्यासेज गरिरहेको रहेछ । र, डिलिट गरिरहेको रहेछ । मेरो आमा-बुबा, दाजु, भाउजू, दिदी कसैलाई मैले गरेको साधनाको बारेमा थाहै छैन र साधना गलत पनि होइन । मेरो कारण परिवारलाई दोष नलाइदिनु होला ।’ खतिवडाले को इनम भनेर स्पष्ट लेखेका छैनन् । उनले के साधना गरे भने पनि खुलाएका छैनन् । उनका छिमेकी तथा साथी लीलाराज झापालीले इनमसँगको सम्बन्धको बारेमा आफूलाई थाहा नभएको बताए । उनले भने, ‘यसु मेरो सानैदेखिको साथी हो । भिडियो र फोटोग्राफी गर्ने यसु केही दिनदेखि मानसिक समस्यामा थियो ।’ परिवारले समयमै खतिवडाको मानिसिक समस्याका बारेमा थाहा नपाएको उनको भनाइ छ । झापालीले भने, ‘उ सामान्य मानिस हो । यस्तो निर्णय गर्छ भन्ने कसैले थाहा पाएन ।’ मानसिक रोगी भएको प्रहरीको दाबी इनमको नाम जोडेर आत्महत्या गरेका खतिवडा मानसिक रोगी भएको प्रहरीले दाबी गरेको छ । जिल्ला प्रहरी कार्यालय झापाका प्रहरी उपरीक्षक वसुन्धरा खड्काले बिचौलिया इनमसँगको सम्बन्धका बारेमा केही नखुलेको बताइन् । उनले भनिन्, ‘उ मानसिक रोगी रहेछ । सोही कारण आत्महत्या गरेको हुन सक्छ ।’ मृतकको पोस्टमार्टम भएको र आजै अन्त्येष्टिका लागि परिवारले शव बुझेको खड्काले बताइन् । घटनाका विषयमा प्रहरीले अनुसन्धान गरिरहेको उनको भनाइ छ । ‘केही कनेक्सन रहेछ भने अनुसन्धान पछि खुल्ला अहिले नै यसै हो भन्न सक्ने अवस्था छैन,’ उनले भनिन् । छिमेकी लीलाराजले आजै उनको अन्तिम दाहसंस्कार गरेको बताए । Biratnagar. Yashu Khatiwada of Kankai Municipality, Jhapa, has committed suicide by linking his name with middleman Inam Sapkota. He had written a status on social media two days before committing suicide. Khatiwada, who was engaged in photography and videography business, was found dead at his home. He ran a photo studio in Laxmipur, Jhapa. According to the District Police Office, Jhapa, he committed suicide by hanging himself in his room. The status written by Khatiwada before committing suicide linked Inam Sapkota, who is in police custody. He wrote, 'Please don't punish my family for my mistakes. I will punish myself. The life I am living today is my punishment. I work for the respect and peace of all religions. All this happened because of my own mind.' Khatiwada has apologized to everyone for his weakness. In another status he wrote, the name of the middleman Inam was mentioned. He claims that the message came from Inam's WhatsApp and was deleted. He wrote, 'The message that is said to have come from Inam's mobile WhatsApp is just a drama created by someone else to trap my family and innocent father. Someone else is sending the message. And, they are deleting it. None of my parents, brothers, sisters, or brothers know about the sadhana I have done and the sadhana is not wrong. Please don't blame my family for it.' Khatiwada has not clearly stated who Inam is. He has not revealed what spiritual practice he has done. His neighbor and friend Leelaraj Jhapali said that he did not know about his relationship with Inam. He said, 'Yesu is my childhood friend. Yesu, who does video and photography, had been in mental trouble for a few days.' He says that the family did not learn about Khatiwada's mental problems in time. Jhapali said, "He is an ordinary person. No one knew he would make such a decision." Police claim he is mentally ill Police have claimed that Khatiwada, who committed suicide by linking his name to Inam, is mentally ill. District Police Office, Jhapa, Superintendent of Police Vasundhara Khadka said that nothing has been revealed about his relationship with the middleman Inam. She said, "He is mentally ill. That may be why he committed suicide." Khadka said that a post-mortem of the deceased has been conducted and the family has received the body for burial today. He said that the police are investigating the incident. "If there is a connection, it is not possible to say for sure right now after the investigation," she said. Neighbor Leela Raj said that his last rites were performed today.

मानसिक रोगी भएको प्रहरीले दाबी गरेको छ । जिल्ला प्रहरी कार्यालय झापाका प्रहरी उपरीक्षक वसुन्धरा खड्काले बिचौलिया इनमसँगको सम्बन्धका बारेमा केही नखुलेको बताइन् । उनले भनिन्, ‘उ मानसिक रोगी रहेछ । सोही कारण आत्महत्या गरेको हुन सक्छ ।’ मृतकको पोस्टमार्टम भएको र आजै अन्त्येष्टिका लागि परिवारले शव बुझेको खड्काले बताइन् । घटनाका विषयमा प्रहरीले अनुसन्धान गरिरहेको उनको भनाइ छ । ‘केही कनेक्सन रहेछ भने अनुसन्धान पछि खुल्ला अहिले नै यसै हो भन्न सक्ने अवस्था छैन,’ उनले भनिन् । छिमेकी लीलाराजले आजै उनको अन्तिम दाहसंस्कार गरेको बताए । Biratnagar. Yashu Khatiwada of Kankai Municipality, Jhapa, has committed suicide by linking his name with middleman Inam Sapkota. He had written a status on social media two days before committing suicide. Khatiwada, who was engaged in photography and videography business, was found dead at his home. He ran a photo studio in Laxmipur, Jhapa. According to the District Police Office, Jhapa, he committed suicide by hanging himself in his room. The status written by Khatiwada before committing suicide linked Inam Sapkota, who is in police custody. He wrote, 'Please don't punish my family for my mistakes. I will punish myself. The life I am living today is my punishment. I work for the respect and peace of all religions. All this happened because of my own mind.' Khatiwada has apologized to everyone for his weakness. In another status he wrote, the name of the middleman Inam was mentioned. He claims that the message came from Inam's WhatsApp and was deleted. He wrote, 'The message that is said to have come from Inam's mobile WhatsApp is just a drama created by someone else to trap my family and innocent father. Someone else is sending the message. And, they are deleting it. None of my parents, brothers, sisters, or brothers know about the sadhana I have done and the sadhana is not wrong. Please don't blame my family for it.' Khatiwada has not clearly stated who Inam is. He has not revealed what spiritual practice he has done. His neighbor and friend Leelaraj Jhapali said that he did not know about his relationship with Inam. He said, 'Yesu is my childhood friend. Yesu, who does video and photography, had been in mental trouble for a few days.' He says that the family did not learn about Khatiwada's mental problems in time. Jhapali said, "He is an ordinary person. No one knew he would make such a decision." Police claim he is mentally ill Police have claimed that Khatiwada, who committed suicide by linking his name to Inam, is mentally ill. District Police Office, Jhapa, Superintendent of Police Vasundhara Khadka said that nothing has been revealed about his relationship with the middleman Inam. She said, "He is mentally ill. That may be why he committed suicide." Khadka said that a post-mortem of the deceased has been conducted and the family has received the body for burial today. He said that the police are investigating the incident. "If there is a connection, it is not possible to say for sure right now after the investigation," she said. Neighbor Leela Raj said that his last rites were performed today.

लेखेका थिए । फोटोग्राफी र भिडियोग्राफी व्यवसाय गर्दै आएका खतिवडा घरमै मृत फेला परेका हुन् । उनी झापाको लक्ष्मीपुरमा फोटो स्टुडियो सञ्चालन गर्थे । जिल्ला प्रहरी कार्यालय झापाका अनुसार उनले कोठामा चुकुल लगाएर आत्महत्या गरेका थिए । आत्महत्या गर्नुअघि खतिवडाले लेखेको स्टाटसमा प्रहरी हिरासतमा रहेका इनम सापकोटालाई जोडिएको छ । उनले लेखेका छन्, ‘मेरो गल्तिको सजाय मेरो परिवारलाई नदिनु होला । म आफूले आफैँलाई सजाय दिने छु । मेरो यो आज भोगिरहेको जिन्दगी नै मेरो लागि सजाय हो । सबै धर्मको सम्मान र शान्तिको काममा गर्दछु । आफ्नै मनको कारण यो सबै हुनभयो ।’ खतिवडाले आफूबाट कमजोरी भएको भन्दै सबैसँग क्षमायाचना गरेका छन् । उनले लेखेको अर्को स्ट्याटसमा भने बिचौलिया इनमको नाम जोडिएको थियो । उनले इनमको ह्वाटस्अपबाट म्यासेज आएको र डिलिट भएको दाबी गरेका छन् । उनले लेखेका छन्, ‘जुन ईनमको मोबाइल ह्वाट्सअपबाट आएको । आत्महत्या गर्नुअघि खतिवडाले लेखेको स्टाटसमा प्रहरी हिरासतमा रहेका इनम सापकोटालाई जोडिएको छ । उनले लेखेका छन्, ‘मेरो गल्तिको सजाय मेरो परिवारलाई नदिनु होला । म आफूले आफैँलाई सजाय दिने छु । मेरो यो आज भोगिरहेको जिन्दगी नै मेरो लागि सजाय हो । सबै धर्मको सम्मान र शान्तिको काममा गर्दछु । आफ्नै मनको कारण यो सबै हुनभयो ।’ खतिवडाले आफूबाट कमजोरी भएको भन्दै सबैसँग क्षमायाचना गरेका छन् । उनले लेखेको अर्को स्ट्याटसमा भने बिचौलिया इनमको नाम जोडिएको थियो । उनले इनमको ह्वाटस्अपबाट म्यासेज आएको र डिलिट भएको दाबी गरेका छन् । उनले लेखेका छन्, ‘जुन ईनमको मोबाइल ह्वाट्सअपबाट आएको भनिएको त्यो मेरो परिवार र निर्दोष बुबालाई फसाउन अरू कसैले रचिरहेका नाटक मात्र हो । अरू नै कसैले म्यासेज गरिरहेको रहेछ । र, डिलिट गरिरहेको रहेछ । मेरो आमा-बुबा, दाजु, भाउजू, दिदी कसैलाई मैले गरेको साधनाको बारेमा थाहै छैन र साधना गलत पनि होइन । मेरो कारण परिवारलाई दोष नलाइदिनु होला ।’ खतिवडाले को इनम भनेर स्पष्ट लेखेका छैनन् । उनले के साधना गरे भने पनि खुलाएका छैनन् । उनका छिमेकी तथा साथी लीलाराज झापालीले इनमसँगको सम्बन्धको बारेमा आफूलाई थाहा नभएको बताए । उनले भने, ‘यसु मेरो सानैदेखिको साथी हो । भिडियो र फोटोग्राफी गर्ने यसु केही दिनदेखि मानसिक समस्यामा थियो ।’ परिवारले समयमै खतिवडाको मानिसिक समस्याका बारेमा थाहा नपाएको उनको भनाइ छ । झापालीले भने, ‘उ सामान्य मानिस हो । यस्तो निर्णय गर्छ भन्ने कसैले थाहा पाएन ।’ मानसिक रोगी भएको प्रहरीको दाबी इनमको नाम जोडेर आत्महत्या गरेका खतिवडा मानसिक रोगी भएको प्रहरीले दाबी गरेको छ । जिल्ला प्रहरी कार्यालय झापाका प्रहरी उपरीक्षक वसुन्धरा खड्काले बिचौलिया इनमसँगको सम्बन्धका बारेमा केही नखुलेको बताइन् । उनले भनिन्, ‘उ मानसिक रोगी रहेछ । सोही कारण आत्महत्या गरेको हुन सक्छ ।’ मृतकको पोस्टमार्टम भएको र आजै अन्त्येष्टिका लागि परिवारले शव बुझेको खड्काले बताइन् । घटनाका विषयमा प्रहरीले अनुसन्धान गरिरहेको उनको भनाइ छ । ‘केही कनेक्सन रहेछ भने अनुसन्धान पछि खुल्ला अहिले नै यसै हो भन्न सक्ने अवस्था छैन,’ उनले भनिन् । छिमेकी लीलाराजले आजै उनको अन्तिम दाहसंस्कार गरेको बताए ।
